_notes.purpose: Schema definition for data/campaign_state.json. Field values here are type descriptors, not live data.
_notes.campaign_state_file: data/campaign_state.json — created by bot when a campaign starts, updated each beat, archived on campaign end.
_notes.nullability: Fields marked 'null until set' will be null in the live file until that phase/action occurs.
_notes.ids: Discord snowflake IDs stored as strings to avoid 64-bit integer precision loss in JSON.
_notes.enlisted: Any member from Watch Master to Watch Brother can opt in via /campaign-enlist. Only enlisted members participate. Roles are inferred from their Discord roles at enlistment time. Cascade slots with no enlisted member = vacant.
_notes.vacant_slots: No role is a hard blocker. Every vacant slot has a bot-randomized fill. WM absent: bot picks planet weighted by pressure (highest-pressure adjacent node first, ties broken randomly), picks scenario, derives best-fit theatre order from scenario dominant tags. Sgt absent: bot randomizes doctrine weighted by HC+Company cascade tag aggregate flowing down. KT Champion absent: bot picks highest-scored eligible mission, no terminus call from that slot. Any specialist absent: 0 tag contribution, cascade continues unblocked. Watch Captain absent: KTs inherit HC theatre tags at 1.0x directly (no company amplification layer). Watch Lieutenant absent: Sgt scores from Captain flow only, no directive layer. Battle-line absent: no effect on cascade or others.
_notes.company_kt_inference: Company and KT membership is inferred from Discord roles — not stored explicitly here. Bot resolves groupings at cascade time.
_notes.pressure: Only nodes with pressure > 0 are stored. Missing key = pressure 0. Thresholds: 3 = Castellan must log, 5 = WM locked into committing next beat, 7 = narrative breach logged and pressure resets to 4.
_notes.pressure_accumulation: Uncommitted planet: +1 per beat. Committed planet: -1 per op completed (floor 0). Siege counts as an op for pressure relief.
_notes.prestige_window: 28-day rolling window. Bot prunes entries older than 28 days on each beat evaluation.

hard_strat.label: Hard Strat
hard_strat.note: Campaign baseline. Absolute difficulty + cascade-mandated strats.

omega_strats.label: Omega + Strats
omega_strats.note: Omega difficulty + cascade-mandated strats. Siege not in campaign scope.

prestige_sources.op_baseline: int — base prestige for completing a qualifying op. Value TBD.
prestige_sources.prestige_mission: +3 if KT ran their Champion's designated mission
prestige_sources.prestige_terminus: +2 if terminus kill met flag+call condition
prestige_sources.judiciar_sentence: +2 if Judiciar-marked HVT executed on eligible mission

_notes.campaign_log: Separate from AAR. Members submit /campaign-log with only the fields that cannot be derived from their matched AAR: strats_active and terminus_killed. Bot infers beat (from AAR timestamp vs beat windows), mission and planet (from AAR mission field via operations.json lookup), difficulty (from AAR difficulty_class), and boss identity (from operations.json terminus_boss). Keyed by sequential int string.
_notes.strat_pool: Cascade tag aggregate determines the beat strat pool. One uniform pool for the entire ops week — not per-rank or per-player. WM confirms/vetoes before ops window opens.
_notes.beat_scenarios: Generated by bot at beat open for current committed planet + all adjacent nodes. N scenarios per planet, range 1-3. Formula: base=2 if game_planet, base=1 if war_world or hive_world, base=0 otherwise; +1 if node pressure>=3; +1 if edge proximity=close, -1 if proximity=far; -1 if beat=3; floor=1, ceil=3. WM picks planet then scenario. Chosen scenario dominant_tags seed cascade option scoring for the beat. Reclamation (11) is always in the eligible pool — no gate, no unlock condition.

enlistment._note: All enlisted members for this campaign. Keyed by Discord user id string. Populated via /campaign-enlist. Cleared on campaign end.

USER_ID.role: string — canonical role name from rank_mappings.json e.g. 'Watch Master'
USER_ID.active: bool — false if they unenlist mid-campaign (cascade slot becomes vacant)

campaign.phase: string — one of: seeding | cascade_HC | cascade_Company | cascade_KT | ops | evaluating | complete
campaign.ended_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp | null until complete
campaign.outcome: null until complete — one of: Full Victory | Costly Victory | Heroic Defeat | Efficient Victory | Holding Action | Last Stand | Lucky Hold | Neglected Front | Rout
campaign.current_node: string — node id from jericho_reach_graph.json e.g. 'Kadaku'
visited_nodes: list of node id strings visited this campaign in order
beat_history: list of beat_record objects — see beat_record schema below

beat_scenarios._note: Generated at beat open. Bot seeds scenarios for current node + all adjacent nodes. WM picks planet then scenario to open cascade. Cleared and regenerated each beat.
beat_scenarios.chosen_planet: string — node id | null until WM submits
beat_scenarios.chosen_scenario_id: string — scenario_id slug | null until WM submits

NODE_ID.pressure_modifier: int — -1 | 0 | +1 (picking this scenario shifts that planet's pressure trajectory)
NODE_ID.narrative: string — one bot-generated sentence flavouring the engagement

pressure._note: Dict of node_id to pressure int. Only non-zero nodes stored. Missing key = pressure 0.

cascade._note: Current beat's cascade state. Reset each beat when cascade phase opens. Vacant slots are omitted — bot fills defaults at evaluation.
cascade.beat: int — which beat this cascade belongs to
scenario_dominant_tags: string — 2 dominant tags from WM's chosen scenario, seeding cascade option scoring

planet_pick.node_id: string — committed planet node id | null until submitted

theatre_order.option_key: string — named option key from cascade_options.json | null until submitted

Lord Executioner.terminus_call: string — terminus target called for engagement | null

Huntmaster.terminus_flag: string — terminus target name flagged for the beat | null

Castellan.log_text: string — Castellan's written narrative reasoning | null

Company._note: One entry per active company. Keyed by Watch Captain discord user id string.

Company Champion.terminus_call: string — terminus target called for engagement | null

KT._note: One entry per active KT. Keyed by Watch Sergeant discord user id string.

oathsworn_votes._note: Advisory votes cast by enlisted Oathsworn before Sgt locks. Keyed by user id.

Watch Sergeant.option_key: string — locked doctrine | null until submitted

Kill Team Champion.mission_id: int — prestige mission picked | null until submitted
Kill Team Champion.terminus_call: string — terminus target called for engagement | null

Judiciar.sentence_target: string — HVT name marked for sentence | null
Judiciar.eligible_mission_id: int — mission id sentence applies to (2 or 9) | null

enlisted_battle_line._note: All enlisted Oathsworn/Watch Veteran/Watch Brother in this KT. Keyed by discord user id. Personal milestone slot deferred.

USER_ID.rank: string — Oathsworn | Watch Veteran | Watch Brother

strat_pool._note: One uniform pool for the entire ops week. Derived from cascade tag aggregate. WM confirms or vetoes before ops window opens. See reference/strat_mandate.json for three-tier derivation logic.
strat_pool.locked: bool — false during cascade, true once WM confirms and ops window opens

cascade_tag_aggregate._note: Snapshot of tag frequencies used to generate the pool. Stored for audit.
cascade_tag_aggregate.tag_name: int — count of cascade picks contributing this tag

strat_pool.theatre_mandate: string — stratagem name mandated for all enlisted members this beat | null

company_mandates._note: Keyed by company identifier. Each company independently derives one strat from the pool.

kt_mandates._note: Keyed by Sgt user ID. Each KT independently derives one strat from the remaining pool.

campaign_log._note: Separate from AARs. Members submit /campaign-log per op with only the fields the bot cannot derive from the matched AAR. Beat, mission, planet, difficulty, and boss identity are all bot-inferred. Keyed by sequential int string.

_bot_inferred.beat: derived from AAR timestamp vs campaign_state beat date windows
_bot_inferred.mission: derived from matched AAR mission field
_bot_inferred.planet: derived from operations.json lookup on mission name
_bot_inferred.difficulty: derived from AAR difficulty_class (hard_stratagem → hard_strat, omega_ops → omega_strats)
_bot_inferred.boss_identity: derived from operations.json terminus_boss on the matched mission — null if roaming-only mission

ENTRY_ID.aar_ref: string — aar_id of the matched AAR record | null if bot auto-matched by member + timestamp proximity
strats_active: list of stratagem name strings active this run — empty list if none
ENTRY_ID.terminus_killed: bool — true if any terminus target was killed this run, false otherwise

prestige_awarded.prestige_mission: int — 0 unless this was the KT Champion's designated mission
prestige_awarded.prestige_terminus: int — 0 unless terminus kill met flag+call condition
prestige_awarded.judiciar_sentence: int — 0 unless Judiciar sentence mark resolved this run

prestige_missions._note: Per-KT designated prestige mission. Keyed by Sgt user id.

terminus_calls._note: Engagement calls from roles with call_engagement mode. Keyed by role name.

judiciar_sentences._note: Active sentence marks for the ops window. Keyed by Judiciar user id.

prestige._note: 28-day rolling window. Keyed by Discord role id string (company or KT role). Pruned on each beat evaluation.

ROLE_ID.label: string — role display name
ROLE_ID.total: int — current prestige total within window
ROLE_ID.tier: string — see campaign_system.md for tier thresholds

entries.source: string — op_baseline | prestige_mission | prestige_terminus | judiciar_sentence | difficulty_bonus

beat_record._note: Archived per beat in campaign.beat_history once ops window closes and bot evaluates.
beat_record.node: string — node id committed this beat
beat_record.theatre_order: string — WM's theatre order option key

pressure_snapshot._note: Pressure values for all tracked nodes at beat close.

beat_record.ops_run: int — total campaign-log entries submitted this beat

terminus_kills.prestige: int — terminus kills that qualified for prestige
terminus_kills.regular: int — terminus kills that did not qualify

strat_pool_snapshot: list of stratagem name strings used this beat
